premises: The mention arises by digression from the main topic.
A weapon is being described in this statement.
The described weapon is characterized as dear to the yoginīs.
inference: The weapon dear to the yoginīs is described incidentally in an address to Akṣobhya.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the weapon is not named in this verse alone.
